definitions.explanation: The part of the body between the neck and upper arm.

examples.english: To pat someone on the shoulder.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもを{肩|かた}に{乗|の}せた。
examples.english: I put the child on my shoulders.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{時間|じかん}パソコンを{使|つか}っていたので、{肩|かた}が{痛|いた}くなった。
examples.english: My shoulders started to hurt because I used the computer for a long time.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}を{肩|かた}にかけて{歩|ある}いていたら、だんだん{肩|かた}が{痛|いた}くなってきた。
examples.english: I was walking with a heavy bag on my shoulder, and gradually my shoulder started to hurt.

notes:
{肩|かた} means shoulder.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {肩|かた}が{凝|こ}る: to have stiff shoulders
- {肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる: to stand shoulder to shoulder
- {肩|かた}を{持|も}つ: to take someone's side
- {肩|かた}の{荷|に}が{下|お}りる: to feel relieved of a burden

COMPOUNDS:
- {肩書|かたがき}: title, position
- {肩車|かたぐるま}: riding on shoulders
